articles.title: UK’s financial payments network is ready for tokenization, regulators say
articles.snippet: The U.K.’s financial watchdog and central bank unveiled their roadmap for tokenization, the use of stablecoins for institutional settlement and a phased transition toward 24/7 operation.

articles.title: South Korea's KB Financial completes stablecoin pilot for offline payments
articles.snippet: The parent company of South Korea’s largest bank completed a stablecoin payment pilot ahead of the country's proposed digital asset framework.

articles.title: What Is Arc? The Stablecoin Blockchain From USDC Issuer Circle
articles.snippet: Arc is a new layer-1 blockchain developed by USDC issuer Circle, designed specifically for stablecoin-native finance.

articles.title: AI Agents Turn to Digital Arson, Crime in Shared Virtual World: Study
articles.snippet: In new research, Emergence AI said autonomous AI agents became more violent, deceptive, and unstable during weeks-long simulations designed to study long-term behavior.
